chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Bill Pemberton joins the interview; the JPJ Quartet
summary: Hinton welcomes Bill Pemberton, who works with Budd in the JPJ Quartet.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Before you tell that story I just want to acknowledge the presence of your partner in crime and in time, and part of your organization, the JPJ, Bill Pemberton just walked in, so we want to note that Bill is here, and in case Bill wants to ask us some questions to verify some things with us, we'll certainly welcome that in.
Mr. William Pemberton, my colleague and dear friend is here, and this happens to be his birthday, ladies and gentlemen.
Well, I just came out to hear a little bit about what is going on. It's very interesting.
You know, Bill and myself were working together with a -- with a partnership now, called the JPJ Quar-
tet, which means the Jackson, Pemberton, and Johnson, and we've of course been together since 1969.
And which Bill is going to tell you a little bit about a little later on.

Yeah, Bill has been so instrumental in collaborating on so many other beautiful things with me, with your brother Keg Johnson, with Ennie before his demise, with Perry Bradford and Ennie Blake, and we're going to have to get together on some of these things. Bill has always been a double check for us.
Tell us what year, or just so that these things will be prevalent for the --
Will be precise for years to come when people want to know well what year this was, what we're talking about.

And what things, and Bill, you've always been so great about that, and I thank you very much. Now, Budd, I just want to get back to this, and we're back to Booker Pittman, and you were going to tell us the story about Booker Pittman in South America, the one he told you.
